title: Ondagona Baa
desc: Raghu comes to his paternal village to attend his grandfather's diamond jubilee function. He finds out that due to his uncle, his family was separated, and tries to fix things.

title: Giri Kanye
desc: Chenna is smitten by Cheluvi, a girl who works in his factory. However, with Chenna's jealous manager in the picture, the lovers struggle to enjoy their developing romance.

title: Abhi
desc: Abhi, a college student in Bangalore, meets Bhanu who stays as a tenant in his house. Despite their differences, they fall in love, which soon sparks trouble in their lives.

title: Thaakath
desc: Basya, a cleaner, was found as an abandoned child and is raised by a driver and a conductor. However, he invites trouble when he falls in love with Bagya, the village head's daughter.

title: Mandya
desc: Ganesh, also known as Eshwar, is compelled to move to the city after the bloodshed in his native town devastates him. When he returns years later, he adopts the task of educating people.
